# Retrieval at scale (generated by scripts/summarize_retrieval.py)

SIT HPC job 4144, node sit-gpu, NVIDIA L40. 300 queries per store (150 single-fact, 150 with an older and a newer record for the same fact), 3 seeds; mean ± population sd over seeds. `nl` = the user's question as the query; `kw` = a short keyword query (project name + attribute words).
